verses.sloka: राममाश्वासयाने तु लक्ष्मणे भ्रातृवत्सले।निक्षिप्य गुल्मान् स्वस्थाने तत्रागच्छद्विभीषणः ।। ६.८४.१ ।।
verses.transliteration: rāmamāśvāsayāne tu lakṣmaṇe bhrātṛvatsale।nikṣipya gulmān svasthāne tatrāgacchadvibhīṣaṇaḥ ।। 6.84.1 ।।

translations.english: As Lakshmana was comforting his affectionate brother, Vibheeshana came to Rama assigning the troops to reach their respective places.
translations.hindi: मकराक्ष को लङ्का से निकलते हुए देख, समस्त वानरयूथपति उछलते कूदते उससे ल ड्ने के लिए तुरन्त तैयार हो गए

verses.sloka: नानाप्रहरणैर्वीरैश्चतुर्भिः सचिवैर्वृतः।नीलाञ्जनचयाकारैर्मातङ्गैरिव यूथपः ।। ६.८४.२ ।।
verses.transliteration: nānāpraharaṇairvīraiścaturbhiḥ sacivairvṛtaḥ।nīlāñjanacayākārairmātaṅgairiva yūthapaḥ ।। 6.84.2 ।।

translations.english: Accompanied by the four ministers surrounded by four ministers resembling leaders of elephants, who looked dark like collyrium, Vibheeshana came to highsouled Rama. He witnessed Vanaras whose eyes were filled with tears.

verses.sloka: सो ऽभिगम्य महात्मानं राघवं शोकलालसम्।वानरांश्चैव ददृशे बाष्पपर्याकुलेक्षणान् ।। ६.८४.३ ।।
verses.transliteration: so 'bhigamya mahātmānaṁ rāghavaṁ śokalālasam।vānarāṁścaiva dadṛśe bāṣpaparyākulekṣaṇān ।। 6.84.3 ।।

translations.english: He (Vibheeshana) saw the great soul, the delight of the Ikshvaku race deluded, distressed, and lying on the lap of Lakshmana.

verses.sloka: राघवं च महात्मानमिक्ष्वाकुकुलनन्दनम्।ददर्श मोहमापन्नं लक्ष्मणस्याङ्कमाश्रितम् ।। ६.८४.४ ।।
verses.transliteration: rāghavaṁ ca mahātmānamikṣvākukulanandanam।dadarśa mohamāpannaṁ lakṣmaṇasyāṅkamāśritam ।। 6.84.4 ।।

translations.english: He (Vibheeshana) saw the great soul, the delight of the Ikshvaku race deluded, distressed, and lying on the lap of Lakshmana.

verses.sloka: व्रीडितं शोकसन्तप्तं दृष्ट्वा रामं विभीषणः।अन्तर्दुःखेन दीनात्मा किमेतदिति सो ऽब्रवीत् ।। ६.८४.५ ।।
verses.transliteration: vrīḍitaṁ śokasantaptaṁ dṛṣṭvā rāmaṁ vibhīṣaṇaḥ।antarduḥkhena dīnātmā kimetaditi so 'bravīt ।। 6.84.5 ।।

translations.english: Vibheeshana was pained to see Rama immersed in grief, depressed in spirit, and asked for What is all this grief for?
translations.hindi: आर कोई कोई राक्षस लोग पाश, मुगइर दरड ओर निखातः ( श्रायुध विशेष ) से वानरों का वध कर रहे थे

verses.sloka: विभीषणमुखं दृष्ट्वा सुग्रीवं तांश्च वानरान्।लक्ष्मणोवाच मन्दार्थमिदं बाष्पपरिप्लुतः ।। ६.८४.६ ।।
verses.transliteration: vibhīṣaṇamukhaṁ dṛṣṭvā sugrīvaṁ tāṁśca vānarān।lakṣmaṇovāca mandārthamidaṁ bāṣpapariplutaḥ ।। 6.84.6 ।।

translations.english: Lakshmana looking at Sugriva's face and also at the Vanaras, his eyes bathed in tears spoke in a dull tone.
translations.hindi: इधर मकराज्ष वानरों पर बाणा की वषा कर रहा था । इससे बे सब वानर घबड़ा कर और भयभीत हो भागने ढगे

verses.sloka: हतामिन्द्रजिता सीतामिह श्रुत्वैव राघवः।हनुमद्वचनात् सौम्य ततो मोहमुपागतः ।। ६.८४.७ ।।
verses.transliteration: hatāmindrajitā sītāmiha śrutvaiva rāghavaḥ।hanumadvacanāt saumya tato mohamupāgataḥ ।। 6.84.7 ।।

translations.english: "O Noble one! On hearing Hanuman that Sita is killed by Indrajith, Rama is deluded', said Lakshmana to Vibheeshana."

verses.sloka: कथयन्तं तु सौमित्रिं सन्निवार्य विभीषणः ।। ६.८४.८ ।।
verses.transliteration: kathayantaṁ tu saumitriṁ sannivārya vibhīṣaṇaḥ ।। 6.84.8 ।।

translations.english: Vibheeshana spoke these meaningful words to Rama, who was unconscious, restraining Saumithri from speaking.
translations.hindi: जब वानर चारों ओर भाग खड़े हुए, तब श्रीरामचन्द्रजी ने उन राक्षसों को उन पर बाणों को वषो कर रोका ( ज्फेकानरों को खवेड रहे थे

verses.sloka: मनुजेन्द्रार्तरूपेण यदुक्तं च हनूमता।तदयुक्तमहं मन्ये सागरस्येव शोषणम् ।। ६.८४.९ ।।
verses.transliteration: manujendrārtarūpeṇa yaduktaṁ ca hanūmatā।tadayuktamahaṁ manye sāgarasyeva śoṣaṇam ।। 6.84.9 ।।

translations.english: "I think that what has been spoken by Hanuman as truth (that Sita has been killed) is like drying up an ocean."

verses.sloka: अभिप्रायं तु जानामि रावणस्य दुरात्मनः।सीतां प्रति महाबाहो न च घातं करिष्यति ।। ६.८४.१० ।।
verses.transliteration: abhiprāyaṁ tu jānāmi rāvaṇasya durātmanaḥ।sītāṁ prati mahābāho na ca ghātaṁ kariṣyati ।। 6.84.10 ।।

translations.english: "O mighty armed Rama! with reference to Sita, you do not know Ravana's opinion. He will never kill Sita."
translations.hindi: जनस्थानवासी मेरे पिता को उसकी सेना और सगे संगातियों सहित मारने बाला दुष्टात्मा राम क्या यही है ?

verses.sloka: याच्यमानस्तु बहुशो मया हितचिकीर्षुणा।वैदेहीमुत्सृजस्वेति न च तत् कृतवान् वचः ।। ६.८४.११ ।।
verses.transliteration: yācyamānastu bahuśo mayā hitacikīrṣuṇā।vaidehīmutsṛjasveti na ca tat kṛtavān vacaḥ ।। 6.84.11 ।।

translations.english: 'Though entreated by me again and again, wishing his welfare, saying “Release Vaidehi”, he never heeded my word.'
translations.hindi: जो राक्षस सैनिक और मेरे सुहृद अभी तक युद्ध में मारे अप हैं, उन सब के बैर का बदला, समस्त बानरों और लद मख सहित इस अत्यन्त दुष्ट राम को मार कर और इसके शरीर से निकले हुए रक्त से ( मृत राक्तसो का ) तर्पण कर में आज चुकाता हूँ

verses.sloka: नैव साम्ना न दानेन न भेदेन कुतो युधा।सा द्रुष्टुमपि शक्येत नैव चान्येन केनचित् ।। ६.८४.१२ ।।
verses.transliteration: naiva sāmnā na dānena na bhedena kuto yudhā।sā druṣṭumapi śakyeta naiva cānyena kenacit ।। 6.84.12 ।।

translations.english: 'Not by conciliation, nor by sowing dissension, nor by gifts — how then by war? She cannot even be seen by any means whatsoever.'

verses.sloka: वानरान् मोहयित्वा तु प्रतियातः स राक्षसः।चैत्यं निकुम्भिलां नाम यत्र होमं करिष्यति ।। ६.८४.१३ ।।
verses.transliteration: vānarān mohayitvā tu pratiyātaḥ sa rākṣasaḥ।caityaṁ nikumbhilāṁ nāma yatra homaṁ kariṣyati ।। 6.84.13 ।।

translations.english: 'That rakshasa has gone back after merely deluding the monkeys. Know, O mighty-armed one, that daughter of Janaka to have been a mere creation of illusion.'

verses.sloka: हुतवानुपयातो हि देवैरपि सवासवैः।दुराधर्षो भवत्येव सङ्ग्रामे रावणात्मजः ।। ६.८४.१४ ।।
verses.transliteration: hutavānupayāto hi devairapi savāsavaiḥ।durādharṣo bhavatyeva saṅgrāme rāvaṇātmajaḥ ।। 6.84.14 ।।

translations.english: 'He will perform a sacrifice at the sanctuary called Nikumbhila; having offered the oblations and returned, even to the gods together with Indra—'

verses.sloka: तेन मोहयता नूनमेषा माया प्रयोजिता।विघ्नमन्विच्छता तत्र वानराणां पराक्रमे ।। ६.८४.१५ ।।
verses.transliteration: tena mohayatā nūnameṣā māyā prayojitā।vighnamanvicchatā tatra vānarāṇāṁ parākrame ।। 6.84.15 ।।

translations.english: '—that son of Ravana becomes unassailable in battle. Surely, seeking to bewilder, he has employed this illusion.'
translations.hindi: वह बलवान राक्षस श्रीरामचन्द्र को ढुँद्ता हुआ, मेघ की तरद गड्गडाहट करते हुए रथ में बेठ, वानरी सेना में बिचरने लगा

verses.sloka: ससैन्यास्तत्र गच्छामो यावत्तन्न समाप्यते।त्यजेमं नरशार्दूल मिथ्यासन्तापमागतम्।सीदते हि बलं सर्वं दृष्ट्वा त्वां शोककर्शितम् ।। ६.८४.१६ ।।
verses.transliteration: sasainyāstatra gacchāmo yāvattanna samāpyate।tyajemaṁ naraśārdūla mithyāsantāpamāgatam।sīdate hi balaṁ sarvaṁ dṛṣṭvā tvāṁ śokakarśitam ।। 6.84.16 ।।

translations.english: 'Wishing, dear one, to put an obstacle in the way of the monkeys' valour, he has done this. Let us therefore go there with the army before that rite is completed.'
translations.hindi: अन्त में महारथी श्रीराम और लक्ष्मण के समीप पहुँच, उसने बड़े जोर से चिल्ला कर ओर हाथ के संकेत से श्रीराम को अपने निकट बुला कर यह कहा

verses.sloka: इह त्वं स्वस्थहृदयस्तिष्ठ सत्त्वसमुच्छ्रितः।लक्ष्मणं प्रेषयास्माभिः सह सैन्यानुकर्षिभिः ।। ६.८४.१७ ।।
verses.transliteration: iha tvaṁ svasthahṛdayastiṣṭha sattvasamucchritaḥ।lakṣmaṇaṁ preṣayāsmābhiḥ saha sainyānukarṣibhiḥ ।। 6.84.17 ।।

translations.english: 'Cast off, O tiger among men, this false grief that has come upon you; for the whole army loses heart on seeing you wasted with sorrow.'
translations.hindi: टिप्पणी--१० से १६ तक की संख्या के श्लोक केवल वास्हीक्लाख प्रस के संस्करण्‌ ही में पाए जाते हैं ।| तिष्ठ राम मया साध इन्द्वयृद्धं ददामि ते । त्याजयिष्यामि ते प्राणान्‌ धनमक्तेः शितेः शरेः

verses.sloka: एष तं नरशार्दूलो रावणिं निशितैः शरैः।त्याजयिष्यति तत् कर्म ततो वध्यो भविष्यति ।। ६.८४.१८ ।।
verses.transliteration: eṣa taṁ naraśārdūlo rāvaṇiṁ niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ।tyājayiṣyati tat karma tato vadhyo bhaviṣyati ।। 6.84.18 ।।

translations.english: 'Stay here with a tranquil heart, full of courage, and send Lakshmana with us, together with the forces that follow.'
translations.hindi: समस्य दातरधर्मकर्मातुतिष्ठन्तमित्वथंः । (मो०) वि ५७४ युद्धकाण्डे तू दृर्डकबन में मेरे पिता को मार चुका है। सो तुमको बात्रघम पालने के लिए अर्थात्‌ लड़ने के लिए अपने सामने खड़ा देख, मेरा क्रोध भड़क रहा है

verses.sloka: तस्यैते निशितास्तीक्ष्णाः पत्रिपत्राङ्गवाजिनः।पतत्रिण इवासौम्याः शराः पास्यन्ति शोणितम् ।। ६.८४.१९ ।।
verses.transliteration: tasyaite niśitāstīkṣṇāḥ patripatrāṅgavājinaḥ।patatriṇa ivāsaumyāḥ śarāḥ pāsyanti śoṇitam ।। 6.84.19 ।।

translations.english: 'This tiger among men with his sharp arrows will make Ravana's son abandon that rite; then will he become fit to be slain.'

verses.sloka: तं सन्दिश महावाहो लक्ष्मणं शुभलक्षणम्।राक्षसस्य विनाशाय वज्रं वज्रधरो यथा ।। ६.८४.२० ।।
verses.transliteration: taṁ sandiśa mahāvāho lakṣmaṇaṁ śubhalakṣaṇam।rākṣasasya vināśāya vajraṁ vajradharo yathā ।। 6.84.20 ।।

translations.english: 'These sharp and keen arrows of his, winged with feathers, fierce as birds of prey, shall drink his blood.'
translations.hindi: हे राम ! मेरे सोभाग्य से आज तू मुझे देख पड़ा हे । में चाहता भी यही था। जैसे भूखा सिंह हिरन की खोज में रहता है, वैसे ही में तेरी खोज में था

verses.sloka: मनुजवर न कालविप्रकर्षो रिपुनिधनं प्रति यत् क्षमो ऽद्य कर्तुम्।त्वमति सृज रिपोर्वधाय वाणीममररिपोर्मथने यथा महेन्द्रः ।। ६.८४.२१ ।।
verses.transliteration: manujavara na kālaviprakarṣo ripunidhanaṁ prati yat kṣamo 'dya kartum।tvamati sṛja riporvadhāya vāṇīmamararipormathane yathā mahendraḥ ।। 6.84.21 ।।

translations.english: 'Therefore, O mighty-armed one, commission the auspicious-marked Lakshmana for the destruction of that rakshasa, as the wielder of the thunderbolt lets loose his bolt.'

verses.sloka: समाप्तकर्मा हि स राक्षसाधिपो भवत्यदृस्यः समरे सुरासुरैः।युयुत्सता तेन समाप्तकर्मणा भवेत् सुराणामपि संशयो महान् ।। ६.८४.२२ ।।
verses.transliteration: samāptakarmā hi sa rākṣasādhipo bhavatyadṛsyaḥ samare surāsuraiḥ।yuyutsatā tena samāptakarmaṇā bhavet surāṇāmapi saṁśayo mahān ।। 6.84.22 ।।

translations.english: 'O best of men, delay is not proper in the slaying of the foe — what can be done today, do. Loose your arrow-power for the destruction of the enemy, as the great Indra did in crushing the city of the asuras.'

verses.sloka: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमद्युद्धकाण्डे चतुरशीतितमः सर्गः ।। ८४ ।।
verses.transliteration: ityārṣe śrīmadrāmāyaṇe vālmīkīye ādikāvye śrīmadyuddhakāṇḍe caturaśītitamaḥ sargaḥ ।। 84 ।।

translations.english: 'For that bull among rakshasas, his rite complete, becomes invisible in battle even to the gods and asuras; and should he give battle with his rite accomplished, even the gods would stand in great peril.'
translations.hindi: चाहे अन्न से, चाहे गदा से, चाहे हाथापाई से, जिसमें तुके लड़ने का अभ्यास हो उससे निपट ले
